notes: This contract records a portable installed-package C++ TCK case for querying a two-attribute object whose attributes have different ownership states. The scenario uses only official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador declarations plus the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider library, multi-attribute FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies the exact Inform Attribute Ownership and Attribute Is Not Owned partitions, and that an ordinary unowned attribute is not reported as RTI-owned. Invalid handles, MOM, removal races, save/restore, and conformance are outside this case.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador::queryAttributeOwnership and isAttributeOwnedByFederate with FederateAmbassador::informAttributeOwnership, attributeIsNotOwned, and attributeIsOwnedByRTI
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador ownership-query declarations
